content_text: I sent a link to a possible solution by email (it seems i can’t put active links in a post, it triggers the “too many redirect” bug too) . Summing up, it could be a bbpress theme problem: do you think it could be the cause?  On bbpress forum there are various other posts about problems with the editing function, even if not directly involving the “too many redirects” issue, but i’d say it’s a function not working properly on bbpress in general.
